about: A friend thought lost. A distress signal from the edge of the solar system. A conspiracy that should have stayed buried.

Play as Agent Sasha Riss in this award-winning, full-length sci-fi campaign. Follow a mysterious signal across moons, orbital stations, and abandoned Volgravian facilities. Every discovery draws you closer to the dangerous force known as Red Matter. (Note: The story continues after the original game, but no prior knowledge is required to jump in.)
Experience a retro-futuristic world brought into extraordinary focus, with exceptional rendering resolution and image sharpness, while making full use of PlayStation®VR2’s unique capabilities:

• Next-Gen Visuals: Experience exceptionally crisp image quality with ultra-high-resolution rendering, 4K-remastered textures, eye-tracked foveated rendering, and buttery-smooth native 120 fps performance with zero reprojection.
• Tactile Immersion: Feel ships launch, machinery move, and weapons fire through advanced headset feedback, controller haptics, and adaptive triggers.
• Solve & Hack: Think your way through physics and logic puzzles, and slice into secure terminals.
• Master the Jetpack: Cross low-gravity environments and navigate hazardous platforms.
• Defend Yourself: Use your tools to manipulate the environment and fight back against Volgravian security drones.
• Play Your Way: Features intuitive, realistic VR physics, plus comprehensive comfort settings including teleportation, smooth locomotion, and seated modes to suit all players.
